drafts.body:
Hi Dana,

A practical first step is to identify one mid-market finance team that is exploring accounting automation.

1. Review the enablement materials: https://www.example1.com
2. Register the opportunity in the partner portal: https://www.example3.com
3. Use your referral link: https://ledgerly.io/ref/P-1042

Quick-start tip: register the deal first so tracking and program support are in place from the beginning.

Best,
Vitor Carro
Partner Commerce | Ledgerly Partner Program

drafts.subject: How is your Ledgerly onboarding going?
drafts.body:
Hi Dana,

Checking in to see whether you have everything you need to introduce Ledgerly to the right finance teams.

One positioning tip: lead with the finance team's workflow challenge, then explain where Ledgerly fits. Keep the conversation practical and peer-to-peer rather than leading with a product pitch.

If you would like help thinking through a potential fit, contact partners@ledgerly.io.

Best,
Vitor Carro
Partner Commerce | Ledgerly Partner Program
